articles.title: Sebi slaps Rs 25 lakh fine on Citrus Check Inns directors
articles.excerpt:
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has imposed a Rs 25 lakh penalty on three directors of Citrus Check Inns for disobeying its orders. The firm had unlawfully gathered funds from investors despite Sebi's prohibitory instructions. The directors claimed these collections were unintentional, attributed to agents and automatic setups. However, Sebi dismissed their argument, holding the directors accountable for the agents' actions.

articles.title: China’s August LNG Imports Set to Drop as High Prices Hit Demand
articles.excerpt:
(Bloomberg) -- China’s imports of liquefied natural gas are set to drop this month from a year earlier, according to ship-tracking data, as higher prices triggered by the war in the Middle East weighed on consumption.

Deliveries are estimated at around 5.2 million tons in August, 18% lower than the same month last year, according to the data from Kpler. That’s a stark contrast from the year-on-year jumps seen over the previous three months, which were supported by a push to refill inventories to meet peak summer demand.

HDFC Bank shares pared early gains and settled 1.5 per cent lower on Monday after the lender said CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan would not seek reappointment when his current term ends in late October.

The stock closed 1.57 per cent lower at 709 on the NSE after hitting a low of 704.15 from an intraday high recorded at 739.75. It was largely unaffected in the pre-open and CAS session.
